title: NBA Showtime - NBA on NBC

widescreen_requirement.gameplay: Expanded horizontal view with original object proportions; game-specific drawing, culling, camera and HUD corrections where required.
widescreen_requirement.menus: Preserve menu proportions and fill unused side areas with color.
completion_requires: Verify extra scenery during gameplay without stretching or cropping
Verify camera and object visibility at both edges
Verify HUD placement and multiplayer views
Verify game menus have colored side areas
Verify live toggle and original view restoration
Verify with supported game image on iOS and Windows
widescreen_requirement.implementation: 368-column PlayStation gameplay expands to a 496-column native canvas with isolated framebuffers; original pixel scale and centered HUD are retained. Picture menus and movies preserve 4:3 with colored external margins.

input_shortcuts: Timed double turbo for spin, turbo-leading shoot/pass for dunk/shove; PS1 Square/Cross/R2 layout.
